name: Adit Warren
author: Erin Carter
description: An Adit variant: the same off-axis glance down a timbered mine gallery, but every support frame is cross-braced with a diagonal cribbing X between its posts, and the frames run denser - a busier, more textured warren of glowing timber receding into the off-centre vanishing depth. Posts, cap beams and braces all shrink away down the same exponential scale ladder, each frame hung with one warm lamp; a pair of rails crossed by sleepers anchors the floor.

params.label: Descent speed
params.effect: Scale-octaves per second the braced timber frames recede into the gallery.

params.label: Frame density
params.effect: Braced frames per scale octave; higher packs the warren into a dense cribbed lattice.

params.label: Timber width
params.effect: Stroke width of the posts, cap beams and cross-braces, in CSS pixels.

params.label: Lamp glow
params.effect: Brightness of the hanging lamp under each cap beam.

params.label: Vanishing point X
params.effect: Horizontal placement of the bore's vanishing depth — left, centred, or (default) pinned to the off-axis right third.

params.label: Vanishing point Y
params.effect: Vertical placement of the vanishing depth — high, centred, or (default) dropped into the lower third.

params.label: Rake
params.effect: How hard the timber verticals shear with height — 0 a square head-on portal, high a steep oblique rake.

params.label: Rail glow
params.effect: Brightness of the glowing floor rails and their bloom converging on the depth.
